title: Read site records from main and the records branch; fail Pages build
summary: Retry of job 20261110-181101-pyj5 (never ran). Make the homepage evidence panel (read_evidence, site.rs) and decisions.html (read_snapshot, decisions.rs) read records/ from main's tree (HEAD) as well as athena/records when present, and make the site build fail when the evidence job 20261029-073603-7kqv cannot be read. Audience: newcomers viewing the live page and the owner reading decisions.html.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the built page shows models, verdict and costs and that an unreadable job fails the build.
fmt, clippy and test criteria included.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read xtask/src/site.rs (read_evidence at ~741 calls decisions::records_tip, then git.ls_tree_under(tip, records/jobs/YYYY-MM/<job>) and cat_blob; build() ends by calling decisions::write) and xtask/src/decisions.rs (read_snapshot reads records/work-items, work-decisions, roles from the branch tip through athena_data::records::check_record_file, and already reads main's records/work-decisions via MAIN_TREE="HEAD"; locate() maps a missing branch to Records::Missing). Also crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs (Git::show_file, ls_tree_under, cat_blob) and crates/athena-git/src/records_branch.rs (resolve_tip, RECORDS_BRANCH). Order to implement: list entries from the HEAD tree first, then the branch tip when present, dedupe by path (branch wins or identical), and a missing branch is no longer an error if main holds the records. check_record_file (crates/athena-data/src/records.rs:1402) is the existing allow-list for work items/decisions/roles; no new record type or file under crates/ is added, so AnyRecord and its round-trip tests are unchanged. The property is measured directly by building the site from a temp git repo with records only on main.

Environment: the Pages workflow checks out main only (shallow) and fetches athena/records with read-only contents permission; data reached is main's tree at HEAD plus the fetched branch. No workflow change is needed because HEAD is already checked out; .github/workflows/pages.yml, athena.toml and defaults.toml stay unchanged. The Pages build failing is done in Rust: build() returns an error when read_evidence fails, so the cargo run step exits non-zero.

Job 20261029-155632-pqgc (landed): its evidence panel is kept; its findings are addressed: no test ran build() (now one does, from a main-only fixture repo); records read as untyped Value (kept as untyped JSON, out of scope to retype); placement via replacen (kept); silent 'could not be read' note (replaced by a build error). Its files xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/src/decisions.rs and CHANGELOG.md remain deliverables here.

Job 20261029-073603-7kqv (landed, throughput review) is cited only as the evidence job whose records live on main; its changes (status.rs, hestia.rs, code_health.rs, store.rs, display.rs, job_plan.rs, records.rs, hestia.md) are kept as landed and not touched, and its findings do not apply to this change.

The request's file list names athena/records, records/jobs, records/ and docs/design/records-history.md as context, not edits: records/ and the branch never change, and the design doc already says (section 13) readers keep reading main until cutover, so no doc edit is expected.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a new test builds the site (build()) from a temp git repository whose records sit only on main (no athena/records branch) and asserts index.html contains the evidence panel with job id, producer model, different verifier model, verdict and per-stage costs.
The same `cargo test -p xtask` run has a test where main holds a November 2026 proposal with a brief, and decisions.html lists it; a proposal decided by a work-decision on main is not listed.
A test where records exist on both main and the records branch shows both are read (a proposal only on the branch and one only on main both appear) with no duplicate entries.
A test shows build() returns an error (and does not write index.html with a failure note) when the evidence job's records cannot be read from main or the branch; verify with `cargo test -p xtask`.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass, including every existing site.rs and decisions.rs test.

`git diff` shows read_evidence in xtask/src/site.rs and read_snapshot in xtask/src/decisions.rs reading the HEAD tree and the records branch; no model names, verdicts or costs are typed into non-test code.

CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing that the homepage evidence panel and decisions.html read records from main as well as athena/records and that the Pages build fails when the evidence job is unreadable.
`git diff` touches only xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/src/decisions.rs and CHANGELOG.md; athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows/pages.yml, records/ and crates/ are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Any change to records/ or the athena/records branch contents
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or the throughput-review work of job 20261029-073603-7kqv
Retyping the evidence reader onto athena-data structs or changing how the section is placed in the header
Homepage content other than the evidence panel; install steps; owner-only link wording
